To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the stochastic Enskog model is a useful tool for studying transport properties of simple fluids, that the stochastic model can be applied with confidence to the repulsive LJP, that the model appears to be applicable to other simple fluids, and that the model is useful in the study of the transport properties of simple liquids.

the stochastic model of the Enskog equation with the choice of smearing function suggested in the work of Leewater yields virial coefficients in excellent agreement with those of the exact theory and transport coefficients in good agreement with those of Enskog theory.

the revised Enskorg kinetic theory with a choice of smearing function suggested in this work provides a very good description of the equilibrium and transport properties of the repulsive LJP and soft-sphere systems.

the stochastic Enskog theory, with the choice of smearing function used here, appears to be a promising tool for the study of the repulsive part, at least, of the Lennards-Jones potential.
